item.title: Google has joined Amazon in attacking Nvidia’s stronghold with AI app developers
item.description: Google has joined Amazon in releasing a developer tool that makes it easy for PyTorch users to move their apps off Nvidia GPUs.

item.title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats
item.description: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat.

item.title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei
item.description: The former Google CEO owns about 1% stake in the leading AI lab, Bloomberg reported.

item.title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps
item.description: Meta's AI companion Muse has surpassed 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days, joining an exclusive group of apps that includes Threads. New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.

item.title: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language
item.description: Electric Plant has built an AI-powered translator to help humans listen to what plants are saying with the subtle electricity coursing through their stems.

item.title: Figma co-founder Dylan Field thinks MCP is not a perfect protocol
item.description: Figma said it plans to support as many standards as possible without exposing all of its data.

item.title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems
item.description: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.

item.title: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving
item.description: Eka Robotics may be the first robotic arm that is actually good at picking a wide range of objects up, and it is so smooth and human-like, it is wowing the industry.

item.title: Otter.ai raises $320 million from General Catalyst’s growth fund for its meeting tool
item.description: Meeting note-taking tool Otter.ai announced on Tuesday that it has raised $320 million from General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund (CVF), which provides capital to startups without diluting equity and gets returns on the results of marketing spend. Otter.ai said that it will use these funds for enterprise growth, go-to-market strategy, international expansion, and product innovation. […]

item.title: Yelp can now call on your behalf to check wait times at a restaurant
item.description: Yelp is embedding numerous new AI features into its app that can do everything from call to check on restaurant wait times to create personalized recommendations that remember your preferences.

item.title: Mamdani says feds have abdicated on AI, urges New Yorkers to push back
item.description: Mayor Zohran Mamdani said Monday night that New Yorkers must resist the narrative that an AI takeover is inevitable and demand regulations that protect the public and put power back in their hands.

item.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45B compute deal
item.description: If the deal goes through, it would be the latest in a long string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year.

item.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
item.description: The idea of embedded evaluators — in which supposedly "neutral" third-party observers are placed inside AI organizations — has been popularized over the last several months, as AI labs grapple with a rash of safety incidents that have spurred concerns over the potential harms of their technology.

item.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
item.description: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents that employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

item.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
item.description: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

item.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
item.description: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

item.title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
item.description: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

item.title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
item.description: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

item.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
item.description: After drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, the Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to remain independent.

item.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
item.description: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.
